scope: Independent continuous ODE integration and metric recomputation, plus half-step convergence for all candidate predictions. Not an independent optimizer, ABF decoder, or validation of the biological mechanism. Numerical gates: RMSE <=0.2mV, max error <=1mV, half-step RMSE <=0.4 times original plus 1e-7. Both step sizes use the same original 10kHz observation times. Phase screens independently recomputed; cutoffs are engineering criteria, not physiological standards.
